translations.web: Not that I seek for the gift, but I seek for the fruit that increases to your account.
translations.bsb: Not that I am seeking a gift, but I am looking for the fruit that may be credited to your account.
translations.kjv: Not because I desire a gift: but I desire fruit that may abound to your account.
translations.asv: Not that I seek for the gift; but I seek for the fruit that increaseth to your account.
